force_law_assessment.scope: Task checks assess the selected insertion scenarios. Force/moment residuals assess endpoint force-law scatter, not every finite-tolerance applied iterate. Applied-load balance is covered independently by coupler regression tests. Sparse post-entry force-vector comparisons are observations without an acceptance threshold. Passing task checks does not establish convergence of full force histories or coupled energy.
